nonBlockingFindings.description: Floor-plan save false negative (orchestrator adjudication question). After a successful PUT, if the follow-up `fetchFloorPlan` GET throws, `handleSave` returns false (apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/settings.floor-plan.tsx:90-108), so the draft stays dirty and the route keeps the consumed `floorPlanVersion`; the next Save sends the stale version and 409s until 'Reload latest floor plan' or a page reload. Adjudicated NON-BLOCKING against VAL-SETUP-011: the write returned 200, incremented floor_plan_version and wrote the floor_plan.save audit row (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1795-1810), unsaved edits still vanish on reload, and the persisted state is what a reload shows. Harm is a misleading 'Failed to save floor plan.' banner plus a forced explicit reload, not a broken or lossy explicit-Save flow.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Derive the saved version and the saved banner from the PUT response (which already returns the new floorPlanVersion, rsv-setup-crud.ts:1818-1824) instead of the follow-up GET, and only treat the write as authoritative; refresh the baseline lazily.

nonBlockingFindings.description: Most setup CRUD passes the constant 'setup' as the `withSetupWrite` lock key (apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-write.ts:56) rather than the org id, so setup mutations serialize globally (over-serialization) and are not mutually excluded against org-keyed booking writes. SQLite's own writer locking plus retryOnSqliteBusy keeps transactions atomic, so no observed data loss; worst case is a retryable 409 and a lost floor_plan_version increment under simultaneous setup writes.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Pass the real org id as the lock key for setup mutations so all writes for an org serialize on one lock.

nonBlockingFindings.description: Pacing rule channel select offers `phone` and `walk_in` (apps/app/.../settings.services.tsx:1178-1182) while the API schema allows only `all|online` (packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts:266, which matches VAL-SETUP-020). Choosing those options produces a 400; the contract-required flows (all|online) work.
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Restrict the select to all|online, or deliberately extend the API/engine channel enum in a later milestone.

nonBlockingFindings.description: `covers_actual` was added by editing migration 0016 in place plus an idempotent ALTER in `refreshReservationsTriggers` (packages/tenant-db/src/migrations.ts:212). That helper runs on the Node/LibSQL path (`migrateTenantDb`) and in seed:reservations, but the Durable Object worker runs only `migrate` (apps/tenant-api/workers/tenant-org.ts:43), so a DO that already applied m0016 would never receive the column. Not reproducible in this mission (nothing has been deployed; fresh DOs, the Node/OCI runtime and all local tenant DBs are correct).
nonBlockingFindings.recommendation: Before any deploy: add a numbered migration for the DO path, or call refreshReservationsTriggers from the DO ensureDb()/provision path.

adjudicationNotes: All four reviewers returned pass with file:line evidence. I spot-verified the highest-risk claims myself: the four contract routes exist (operator-reservations-book.ts:293 /conflicts, :1065 /reservations/:id/events, :1372 /contact-status, :1478 /course-status); the location-summary service shape (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1893-1917) matches the App schema (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/region-confirmation.ts:35-43); `covers`/`coversActual` are accepted and written with the documented precedence plus the guest-counter bump (rsv-booking-service.ts:2486-2560); and the floor-plan save flow (settings.floor-plan.tsx:88-108, floor-plan-canvas.tsx:598-635).

Orchestrator adjudication (settings.floor-plan.tsx handleSave after a failed post-save refetch): NON-BLOCKING. VAL-SETUP-011 remains satisfied — an explicit Save returns 200 with an incremented floor_plan_version and a floor_plan.save audit row, unsaved edits still vanish on reload, and a reload shows the persisted plan. The defect is a false-negative error report plus a stale local expectedFloorPlanVersion that forces an explicit 'Reload latest floor plan' (or page reload) before further saves; recommended fix is to take the version from the PUT response.
